يغتربوا (form VIII)
# يَغْتَرِبُوا (yaḡtaribū) /jaɣ.ta.ri.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
# يُغْتَرَبُوا (yuḡtarabū) /juɣ.ta.ra.buː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِغْتَرَبَ (iḡtaraba)
